proposals.proposed: Sets the radius of each filament vertex from the given input image. Please note that if the C/T coordinates are set to zero, the value is extracted from the 0/0 slice.

proposals.current: TSOAX is an open source software to extract and track the growth and deformation of biopolymer networks from 2D and 3D time-lapse sequences. It tracks each filament or network branch from complex network dynamics and works well even if filaments disappear or reappear. The output is a set of tracks for each evolving filament or network segment. TSOAX is an extension of SOAX (for network extraction in static images) to network extraction and tracking in time lapse movies. TSOAX facilitates quantitative analysis of network dynamics of multi-dimensional biopolymer networks imaged by various microscopic imaging modalities. The underlying methods of TSOAX includes multiple Stretching Open Active Contour Models for extraction and a combined local and global graph matching framework to establish temporal correspondence among all extracted structures.
proposals.proposed: Finds and tracks filaments in 3D+T time-lapse sequences with TSOAX, yielding a track for each evolving filament or network segment. TSOAX works well even if filaments disappear or reappear; it is an extension of SOAX (network extraction in static images) to time-lapse movies, and facilitates quantitative analysis of biopolymer network dynamics across imaging modalities. It uses Stretching Open Active Contour Models for extraction and local and global graph matching for temporal correspondence.

proposals.proposed: Connects existing filament vertices based on customizable criteria. Uses expressions to filter candidate edges, which can be slow.

proposals.current: Connect existing vertices based on distance. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
proposals.proposed: Fast variant: connects existing filament vertices based on distance.

proposals.current: Produces a list of 3D ROIs from 3D filament data, optionally drawing filament segments as 3D line ROIs and points as 3D point ROIs. You can override line thickness or point radius.
proposals.proposed: Converts 3D filament data into a list of 3D ROIs, optionally drawing filament segments as 3D line ROIs and points as 3D point ROIs. You can override line thickness or point radius.

proposals.current: Iteratively removes vertices that have a degree of at most 1
proposals.proposed: Erodes the filament by iteratively removing end vertices, i.e. vertices that have a degree of at most 1

proposals.proposed: Attempts to fix overlapping filaments that are merged together by junctions. Please note that this operation assumes that all filaments are non-branching.

Please note that the generated filaments are were automatically simplified by the method and might not fully represent anymore all structural information contained within the skeleton. Use 'Binary skeleton to 2D filaments' or 'Binary skeleton to 3D filaments' to if you are unsure about the functionality of this node. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
proposals.proposed: Extracts filaments from a binary skeleton with the Analyze Skeleton (2D/3D) plugin from Fiji. Please note that the generated filaments were automatically simplified by the method and might not fully represent all structural information contained in the skeleton. Use 'Binary skeleton to 2D filaments' or 'Binary skeleton to 3D filaments' if unsure about this node's functionality.

proposals.proposed: Subdivides the filament edges by inserting a vertex at the center of edges. The connectivity and shape of the filament is preserved.
